org.tmt.aps.peas.frame.model

Class MarkedSubimage

  • java.lang.Object
    • org.tmt.aps.peas.frame.model.MarkedSubimage

  • public class MarkedSubimage
extends Object
    Data for a marked subimage. This should be subclassed from the Subimage class. Contains additional fields useful in tracking marking.

    smichaels
